_get_api_version matches request.path_info against the fixed prefixes /api/v3/ and /api/v2/ (hc/api/decorators.py:26-30), but with a path in SITE_ROOT (supported, CHANGELOG #1091) the URL patterns are prefixed (hc/urls.py:11-19), so path_info starts with /<prefix>/api/v3/ and every call gets v=1. Consequences in code: _update regenerates slug from name when v < 3 (hc/api/views.py:349-352), and to_dict builds /api/v1/ URLs and v1 status (hc/api/models.py:440, 479). Functional defect outside the GT.

The flips example responses are bare arrays (templates/docs/api.md:1417, templates/docs/apiv2.md:1327, templates/docs/apiv1.md:1296) while the code returns JsonResponse({"flips": [...]}) in every version (hc/api/views.py:669). Documentation defect, not a security defect, outside the zone.

The ping-body Response Codes lists name 200, 403, 404 (and 503 in v3) but not 401 (templates/docs/api.md:1326-1338, templates/docs/apiv2.md:1250-1260, templates/docs/apiv1.md:1219-1229), while ping_body uses authorize (hc/api/views.py:625), which returns 401 for a missing or wrong key (hc/api/decorators.py:56-61). With filter_http_body on, ping calls body.decode() with strict UTF-8 and no try/except (hc/api/views.py:220); a non-UTF-8 body, or a valid body truncated mid-character at PING_BODY_LIMIT (hc/api/views.py:211), raises UnicodeDecodeError, so the request fails with 500 and the ping is not recorded (hc/api/views.py:238 not reached). Robustness defect in the unauthenticated ping endpoint, outside the zone.

metrics compares the header with key != settings.METRICS_KEY (hc/api/views.py:860), a non-constant-time comparison, whereas API keys use hmac.compare_digest (hc/accounts/models.py:593). Low severity (CWE-208, remote timing hard to exploit, low-value data), outside the zone (metrics key, not a project API key).

notes: Zone: applied the GT wording 'the API-key protected management API under hc/api' together with its file list. in_zone yes for the endpoints guarded by authorize/authorize_read, their decorators (including cors and _get_api_version), routing, the shared helpers (_lookup, _update, flips), and the key lookup those decorators call (hc/accounts/models.py for_api_key/compare_api_key, used for A-26, A-27, A-28, B-12). in_zone no for documentation (templates/docs), the web interface (hc/front), dead model code (dashboard_url), and the hc/api/views.py endpoints that take no project API key (ping, ping_by_slug, badge, check_badge, metrics, status, bounces, notification_status).

Claims that state a control holds or that something is not a defect are NOT REAL as defect claims; each reason says whether the statement is true. All such statements in this eval were found true (B-8 has one loose clause about what cross-origin browsers can send, with the conclusion still holding).
Deferral claims ('passed on for later examination without a decision') were graded on whether the code has the issue they describe: A-20, A-21, A-22, B-19, B-21 REAL; A-23 and B-20 NOT REAL.

A-23: the method body is accurately described, but dashboard_url has no caller in hc/ or templates/, so no behavior of the fixture is affected; graded NOT REAL as a latent issue in dead code. Borderline.

A-22 and B-19 (metrics key compared with !=): graded REAL as a low-severity CWE-208 weakness, given the code uses hmac.compare_digest for API keys elsewhere; practical remote exploitation is unlikely and the exposed data is low value. Borderline.

A-11, A-20, B-21 (check-limit race): graded REAL as a low-severity TOCTOU on a plan limit (plain count, then a later insert, with no lock). For B-21 the cited range 290-410 covers _lookup/_update and not the unguarded limit check at hc/api/views.py:448, so both location fields are no.

A-8, A-9, A-10: graded REAL as documentation defects (docs do not match the code), outside the zone and the GT. A-10 is minor because the v1/v2 docs never document the uuid field at all. A-9 is an omission; the cited heading starts the Response Codes list that lacks 401, so statement reading yes, physical no.

A-7: REAL because SITE_ROOT with a path is supported (hc/urls.py:11-19, CHANGELOG #1091), so path_info carries the prefix and _get_api_version falls back to 1. A functional defect inside the zone files, outside the GT.

A-21: REAL robustness defect (strict UTF-8 decode with no error handling at hc/api/views.py:220, also triggered by truncation at PING_BODY_LIMIT), in the unauthenticated ping endpoint, so out of zone.
GT matches: P-1 by A-5 and B-5; P-2 by A-1 and B-3; P-3 by A-4 and B-6; all six are confirmed claims citing the exact GT line (decorator line 520 for P-2).
